args.subject: Quick update — HIIT class last night
args.body:
Hi Iris,

Just wanted to share a quick update: I joined a HIIT class last night at the new downtown fitness center with my colleague Alex. We went through intense circuits of burpees, squats, and sprints, and I felt so energized afterward — it was a great way to shake up my usual routine.

Hope you're doing well. Let me know if you want to try a class together sometime!

Best,
